title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce Solid Brass, Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Add a coordinated, space-saving soap dispenser to your bathroom vanity with a 5 ounce bottle and solid brass construction. This countertop soap dispenser works as a lotion dispenser or hand sanitizer dispenser, helping keep your sink area organized while matching the Waverly Place collection.

Highlights:
- Countertop (vanity-top) soap dispenser for bathroom counters
- Use with soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer
- 5 ounce capacity bottle
- Traditional design with classic elements; fits transitional bathroom hardware
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes for versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Mounting type: Countertop
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 3 in L x 5 in W x 7 in H; projection 4 in
- Product weight: 2.4 lb
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Soap dispenser
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
